title: 第21章 何谓亲传第22章 斗心蜕变
slug: 符心护剑重建三十三重天
content_zh:
苏醒入门当天，就往自己身上拍了张【文昌符】。
没有任何用处，也对，这“本我”
修炼，连个面板都没有，熟练度更是无从加起。
当十天后，当苏醒完整地演练完一遍《百炼钢体诀》，收功凝立之时。
站在一旁的罗璇轩脸上表情复杂得几乎扭曲，仿佛正强忍着某种情绪。
苏醒定定地望着他，不明白这位助理又发了什么疯。
良久，罗璇轩长叹一口气，声音低沉得几乎像是在自言自语：“你知道吗，我真的很羡慕你，嫉妒你，甚至……恨不得毁灭你。”
他顿了顿，语气中透出浓浓的不甘：“在办公室里对战的时候，我能清晰地感觉到，你其实并没有战斗天赋。”
他抬起眼，目光如刀，“为什么你能觉醒战斗职业，我却只能觉醒生活职业？”
“原本我并不看好你，只是想按部就班完成大哥的吩咐。”
罗璇轩的拳头不自觉地握紧，指节发白，“可现在……你的天资如此，我只能全力辅助你。
我好气啊，气这命运弄人，更气我自己居然不得不认。”
说到这里，罗璇轩突然做了一个让苏醒完全意想不到的动作。
“练习功法，有所谓的假传万卷书，真传一句话。”
他一边说，一边开始解自己西装外套的扣子。
苏醒愣在原地，不明所以地看着他。
“这几天，我认真辅导你的每一个动作，指出你动作中的失误和错误——这就是那‘真传一句话’。”
罗璇轩脱掉上衣，扔掉领带，手指继续移向衬衫纽扣，动作不疾不徐，却带着一种豁出去的意味。
“这些细节，是秘籍书本上绝不会记载的。
习武之人哪有那么好的文笔，将一切事无巨细写在纸上？

何况那些创出功法的天纵之才，他们视若常识的技巧，往往就忽略不写，但普通人又从哪里得知？”
罗璇轩脱掉衬衫，露出精壮的上身，八块腹肌线条分明。
接着，他竟然开始解皮带，苏醒顿时大惊失色，几乎要跳起来。
“武道传承里，还有一句老话：要想学得会，得陪师傅睡。”
罗璇轩语气平淡，却已经开始脱裤子。
苏醒瞪大眼睛，连退几步，嘴上不由得大叫：
“罗助理，你别这样！
我要叫了，我真的不好这一口！
我不学了，我宁死不学了！”
“闭嘴！”
此刻的罗璇轩浑身上下只剩一条三角内裤，雕塑般的肌肉在训练室的灯光下显得格外醒目，每一寸都仿佛蕴藏着爆发力。
“要不是为了大哥的心愿，我宁死也不会用这种方式教你。”
他吸气起势，摆出《百炼钢体诀》的起手式，声音沉稳而清晰：
“现在，用你的眼睛看，用你的心记。
我练功时身上每一丝肌肉群的抽动、每一处发力的细节——这就是亲传。”
苏醒顿时醒悟，罗璇轩为了堂哥罗天威的心愿，竟不惜牺牲到如此地步，而受益人正是自己。
他心头一震，立即敛容立正，抬起右手，握拳后伸出食指和中指，回臂靠身，将手指郑重地点在自己胸口，随后深深鞠躬
——这是启点镇最高规格的谢礼，代表铭记恩情、永志不忘。
罗璇轩如此牺牲，苏醒不能不郑重回应，大恩不言谢，却必刻于心间。
content_en:
On the day I entered Su Xing, I took a picture of the [Wenchang Talisman] on myself.
It's of no use, that's right, this "self"
For training, there is not even a panel, and there is no way to increase proficiency.
Ten days later, when Su Xing finished practicing the "Hundred Refining Steel Body Technique" completely, he finished his work and stood still.
The expression on Luo Xuanxuan's face, standing aside, was so complex that it was almost distorted, as if he was suppressing some emotion.
Su Xing looked at him steadily, wondering why the assistant was so crazy.
After a long time, Luo Xuanxuan let out a long sigh, and his voice was so low that it was almost as if he was talking to himself: "You know, I really envy you, I'm jealous of you, and even... I want to destroy you."
He paused, and his tone was full of reluctance: "When we were fighting in the office, I could clearly feel that you actually have no fighting talent."
He raised his eyes, his eyes like daggers, "Why can you awaken the combat profession, but I can only awaken the life profession?"
"Originally, I wasn't optimistic about you. I just wanted to fulfill my brother's instructions step by step."
Luo Xuanxuan's fists clenched unconsciously, and her knuckles turned white, "But now... you are so talented, I can only help you with all my strength.
I'm so angry, angry that fate has tricked people, and even more angry that I have to admit it. "
Speaking of this, Luo Xuanxuan suddenly made a move that Su Xing completely unexpected.
"When practicing skills, there is a so-called false teaching of thousands of books, and a true teaching of one sentence."
As he spoke, he began to unbutton his suit jacket.
Su Xing froze on the spot, looking at him in confusion.
"In the past few days, I have carefully coached your every move and pointed out the mistakes and errors in your movements - this is the 'true message'."
Luo Xuanxuan took off his shirt, threw away his tie, and continued to move his fingers to the buttons of his shirt. His movements were slow and slow, but with a sense of risk.
“These details will never be recorded in secret books.
How can a martial arts practitioner have such good writing skills that he can write down everything on paper in detail?
What's more, those geniuses who create martial arts often ignore the skills they regard as common sense, but where do ordinary people learn about them? "
Luo Xuanxuan took off his shirt, revealing his muscular upper body and clearly defined eight-pack abs.
Then, he actually started to take off his belt. Su Xing was shocked and almost jumped up.
"There is an old saying in the martial arts heritage: If you want to learn well, you have to sleep with the master."
Luo Xuanxuan's tone was calm, but she had already started to take off her pants.
Su Xing's eyes widened, he took a few steps back, and couldn't help shouting:
"Assistant Luo, don't do this!
I'm going to scream, I really don't like this!
I don’t want to learn anymore, I would rather die than learn anymore! "
"Shut up!"
At this moment, Luo Xuanxuan was wearing only a pair of briefs. Her sculpted muscles were particularly eye-catching under the lights of the training room, and every inch seemed to contain explosive power.
"If it weren't for big brother's wish, I would rather die than teach you this way."
He inhaled and raised his posture, assuming the starting position of "Hundred Steel Refining Techniques", his voice was calm and clear:
“Now, see with your eyes and remember with your heart.
The twitching of every muscle group on my body and the details of every force exerted during my practice - this is my personal experience. "
Su Xing suddenly realized that Luo Xuanxuan had sacrificed to such an extent for the sake of his cousin Luo Tianwei's wish, and the beneficiary was himself.
His heart was shocked, and he immediately stood upright, raised his right hand, made a fist, stretched out his index and middle fingers, leaned back, placed his fingers solemnly on his chest, and then bowed deeply.
——This is the highest level of thank you gift in Qidian Town, which means remembering the kindness and never forgetting it.
Luo Xuanxuan made such a sacrifice, and Su Xing had to respond solemnly. He said no words of thanks for the great kindness, but it will be engraved in his heart.
